svg.title: Rotation sensing with passive RFID tags (TIMU)
svg.desc: A ball carrying a passive RFID tag spins in front of one linearly polarized reader antenna. As the tag turns, the polarization mismatch γ changes, so the received signal strength and phase rise and fall periodically. Model curves for candidate rotation axes are compared with the measured signal and the best match gives the axis; counting RSS peaks gives the rotation speed.

g.text: A battery-free RFID tag spins with the ball
Polarization mismatch γ shapes RSS and phase
Fit the signal model → rotation axis
Tag and antenna are both linearly
polarized: the signal depends on how
the tag is oriented as the ball turns
Model → expected RSS & phase per axis
a DNN gives the initial axis guess;
refine it to the best match
